name: get_344764_czab
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import json,subprocess,sys,os,re
LANE=os.getcwd()
plan={"url":"https://arxiv.org/pdf/1905.06753","routes":["344764"],"destination":"sources/1905.06753.pdf","source_identity":"Czabarka Dankelmann Olsen Szekely, Wiener Index and Remoteness of Planar Triangulations and Quadrangulations, arXiv 1905.06753","purpose":"Read the original conjecture, its constructions and proven asymptotic bound behind 344764"}
w=os.path.join(LANE,'write_lane.py')
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',w,'plans/get-344764-czab.json'],input=json.dumps(plan,indent=1),text=True,capture_output=True);print('w',r.returncode,r.stderr)
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',os.path.join(LANE,'source_get_guard.py'),'plans/get-344764-czab.json'],text=True,capture_output=True)
print('g',r.returncode);print(r.stdout[:500]);print(r.stderr[:500])
if r.returncode==0:
    t=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout','sources/1905.06753.pdf','-'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout
    w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',os.path.join(LANE,'write_lane.py'),'sources/1905.06753.txt'],input=t,text=True,capture_output=True)
    print(len(t),w.returncode)
    print(t[:6000])
    for m in list(re.finditer(r'Conjecture|5-connected',t))[:30]:
        print('@@',m.start(),t[max(0,m.start()-150):m.start()+350].replace('\n',' '))
